description: This script checks for the existence of a configuration file and sets up environment variables for Ethernet addresses based on the board type. It includes conditional logic for different hardware models and interacts with system files and environment settings relevant to network configuration.

methods.name: fw_printenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values from the firmware environment.

methods.name: fw_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables in the firmware environment.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Utility function to add a value to a MAC address.
